gmat_focus.note: Not published: no median or average is printed. Duke's own class profile page gives the Class of 2028 a middle 80 percent GMAT Focus range of 605 to 715 and nothing else; GMAC's article on the Class of 2027 gives a middle 80 percent of 680 to 770 under the previous scoring system, with its writer's estimates of about 615 and 735 on the current scale. The 665 once recorded here is printed by neither (INC-0154).

gmat_classic.note: Not published: GMAC's article on the Class of 2027 gives a middle 80 percent of 680 to 770 under the previous scoring system and no median or average, and Duke's Class of 2028 page gives no previous edition figure. The 720 once recorded here is printed by neither (INC-0154).

notes: GMAT and GPA: Duke's own class profile page gives the Class of 2028 only middle 80 percent ranges, GMAT Focus 605 to 715, GRE Verbal and Quant combined 307 to 330, EA 150 to 162 and undergraduate GPA 3.15 to 3.90, with no average or median, so GMAT and GPA are empty. GMAC's article on the Class of 2027 gives a GMAT middle 80 percent of 680 to 770 under the previous scoring system and no median; the Focus 665 and Classic 720 medians once recorded were printed by neither and were removed on 2026-09-27 (INC-0154). Acceptance rate: GMAC's article gives around 22 percent for the Class of 2027; Duke's own pages publish none. QS 2026 and P&Q 2025-2026 ranks not seen and nulled. Fuqua's Class of 2025 median base salary fell from $175,000 to $160,000 per P&Q. Prior tuition figure (81,000, 2025-26 official COA PDF) superseded by the official 2026-27 rate of 83,700.

review.stat: All admitted students are considered for merit scholarship awards with no separate scholarship application required; recipients are automatically considered for named scholarships funded by Fuqua and corporate sponsors. Awards range from partial to full tuition
